vulnerability.name: USN-8535-1
vulnerability.description: It was discovered that PipeWire accepted unbounded Content-Length values in its RAOP module. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a denial of service. This issue only affected Ubuntu 24.04 LTS. (CVE-2026-14324)  It was discovered that PipeWire performed multiple unbounded stack allocations in its PulseAudio protocol server. A local attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a denial of service. (CVE-2026-14330)

statements.status_notes: Several security issues were fixed in PipeWire.
